observations: Three photos show a black PlayStation console in a box-like presentation (front and back views).
Photo 0 shows the front with a PlayStation logo and the text watermark “POSTED ON JJI” and “WILCOX HARRY”.
Photo 1 shows the top/front surface with the PlayStation logo watermark.
Photo 2 shows the back panel with multiple ports/buttons visible (no clear model label readable).
No photo shows the console powered on, no controller, no cables, no storage details, and no visible model number/serial sticker.

claims.claim: PS4 Pro packs in twice the GPU power of the standard PS4 – letting you experience incredible image...
claims.evidence: No photo shows the exact model (PS4 Pro vs standard PS4) or any hardware specs/label.

risks.risk: The console may not be a PS4 Pro (could be standard PS4 or another PS4 variant), which changes value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console model/serial label (sticker) showing the exact model number (e.g., CUH-xxxx) and region.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a standard PS4 (worst case vs PS4 Pro).

risks.risk: Unknown condition (may have faults like overheating, disc drive issues, or HDMI/port problems). Photos don’t confirm it works.
risks.proof: A short video clip of power-on to the home screen plus a quick test: insert a disc (if disc drive exists) or show game loading from the menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not fully working / needs testing.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (controller, HDMI cable, power cable, stand, original box) can reduce value significantly.
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing every included item (controller(s), cables, headset, box, receipt/warranty if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as console only (worst case).

risks.risk: Storage size and whether it’s upgraded (HDD/SSD capacity) is not shown.
risks.proof: A photo of System Settings → Storage showing total capacity and free space.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as the lowest common storage configuration.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the model/serial sticker with the CUH model number (front/back label).
Video: power on to the PS home screen (and quick navigation).
Video/photo: show included accessories laid out (controller, HDMI, power cable, any box).
response.reason: From the photos, it’s only possible to confirm it’s a PlayStation console body, but the exact PS4 model (Pro vs standard) and working condition/accessories are not verifiable. Without that, a safe worst-case price can’t be confidently set.
